name: Clocked Fill Example - Employee Onboarding Documentation
description: Fill/generate onboarding documentation using the Clocked Fill API with extracted employee data

fields.start_date: Revised start date of the current starter
fields.office: Office location of the current starter
fields.equipment_description: Individual equipment items requested for the current starter
fields.manager: Assigned line manager of the current starter; empty if not assigned
fields.contact: Personal contact email of the current starter
fields.previous_starter: Name of the previous starter for reference
fields.previous_start_date: Start date of the previous starter
fields.previous_manager: Name of the previous starter's manager
